overview.inspiration: StarAdmin 2 Pro (BootstrapDash) reference screenshot with crisp white sidebar, top header greeting ('Good Morning, [Name]'), soft subtle background (#F4F5F7), pure white rounded cards, large bold KPI numbers with positive (+ green) and negative (- red) badge deltas, cobalt royal blue primary accent (#1F3BB3 / #0D6EFD), and complete removal of the prior forest-green theme.
overview.user_directive: Replicate StarAdmin 2 Pro visual style across all three roles: Inserzionista (user), Comune, Superadmin. The user role MUST now also have a full sidebar dashboard layout (UserDashboard / BackofficeLayout) for order and consistency. Color palette is strictly BLUE (no more green #2F5B41).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the old olive-green palette (#2F5B41, #F2F3F0, #D8EADB) in index.css with the StarAdmin 2 Pro Blue palette (Primary: #1F3BB3, Background: #F4F5F7, Light Blue: #F0F4FF, Card: #FFFFFF).

2. Update BackofficeLayout.jsx to adopt StarAdmin 2 Pro layout: clean white sidebar with crisp borders (#E5E9F2), rounded-xl nav links with blue active state (#1F3BB3) and soft hover (#F0F4FF), sticky top header featuring the iconic 'Good Morning, {user?.nome}' greeting with date/subtitle and actions (search, notification bell, user avatar).

3. Wrap the Inserzionista (user) pages (UserDashboard, Home/Pratiche, Campagne, OOHPlanner, Catalogo) into the BackofficeLayout or provide a unified User Sidebar matching StarAdmin 2 Pro so that advertisers enjoy the neat, ordered sidebar experience requested by the user.

4. Eliminate all remaining hardcoded green color hexes (#2F5B41, #1F5B33, #D8EADB, #EEF2EC) in buttons, badges, selection states, scrollbar thumbs, and Leaflet containers, replacing them with the StarAdmin Royal Blue hierarchy (#1F3BB3, #172E93, #E8EFFF).

5. Format KPI widgets across UserDashboard, Comune Scrivania, and AdminDashboard with bold numbers (text-2xl or text-3xl font-extrabold), muted uppercase labels, and clear green/red positive/negative delta badges (+14%, -3%) matching the StarAdmin 2 Pro card layout.
6. Include a standout StarAdmin featured accent card in royal blue gradient ('bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1F3BB3] to-[#2B4BDB] text-white') on primary dashboards for high visual impact.
7. Recharts bar/line/donut charts should use #1F3BB3 (primary), #52CDFF (light blue), and #FFA800 (warm accent) instead of green shades.
8. Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have rigorous kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered cards and uniform styling. Use StarAdmin 2 Pro's distinctive crisp asymmetry: clean white structural cards on subtle neutral canvas (#F4F5F7), vibrant cobalt blue highlights, and purposeful data hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use universal 'transition: all'. Apply targeted transitions: 'transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous breathing room: p-5 to p-6 inside cards, gap-4 to gap-6 between dashboard widgets, sticky top headers with z-30.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all body text on cards (#1F2937 or #484B5B against #FFFFFF or #F4F5F7). Text on primary blue buttons (#1F3BB3) must be pure white (#FFFFFF).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner toasts with clean rounded borders and subtle shadows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testids: Every button, link, tab, KPI metric, and table row MUST retain or include role-based `data-testid` attributes.
